name: Create
summary: UK-based hosted website builder with templates, a blog, custom forms and an online shop with card and pay-later payments, marketplace shopping feeds and Royal Mail shipping, plus a dedicated account manager on every package.
best_for: UK sole traders, makers and small shops that want a hosted website and a modest online shop with an account manager and UK-based support, rather than a builder they have to learn alone
skip_if: you sell digital products, want basket recovery or rely on Google or Instagram shopping but want to pay the middle price, since those tools are Business-only; more than one person needs to edit on Professional, which has one administrator; or you want control over layout and code, where a designer's builder such as Webflow goes further
honest_knock:
The middle package is a shop with most of the shop tools missing. Professional's ecommerce column on the pricing page has a 250-product limit and discount codes, and then a dash on nine lines: abandoned basket recovery, Instagram and Facebook Shopping, selling digital products, Google Shopping, Klarna, PayPal pay-later, Pinterest Shopping, product customisation and Royal Mail Click & Drop. If you sell downloads, want basket-recovery emails or want your products in Google Shopping, the real price is Business at €39.99 a month, twice Professional.

The prices are shown without VAT. The page says VAT is added at the prevailing rate for your country, so a seller who cannot reclaim it pays more than the headline: at 20%, Business is €47.99 a month. The page also showed us euros from the Netherlands; check which currency your account will be billed in before you compare it with a dollar-priced builder.

Team editing is thin below the tailored tier. Professional allows one website administrator and Business three; only Tailored, from €79.99, mentions permissions for unlimited staff. A shop with a part-time helper on Professional means sharing one login.

Two things the pricing page does not tell you: how long the free trial lasts, and what card payments cost. It lists no transaction fee of Create's own, but the card fees belong to the payment provider you connect, such as Stripe, PayPal, WorldPay or Opayo. The many customer quotes on the package pages are Create's own selection.

The terms of Create Internet Limited (company 03821624, registered in England and Wales) add four things to know before you sign up. The trial is given at Create's discretion and stops when it ends; you then get an email and have 90 days to subscribe, after which all content in the account is deleted. Cancelling is not a button: the terms ask you to email your Customer Account Manager, the account closes the day before the next payment, and deleting your website does not count as notice, so payments continue. Consumers have fourteen working days after the subscription confirmation to cancel for a full refund. And clause 13.6 says you cannot own a copy of your website and will lose it if Create can no longer host it, so keep your own copies of everything you upload.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Portfolio · per month billed monthly, excluding VAT (€8.33 a month billed yearly), 10 pages and no shop
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-03 on create.net/pricing and the package pages, shown to us in euros and excluding VAT) Three packages and a tailored tier, paid monthly or yearly with no fixed contract. Portfolio is €9.99 a month, or €8.33 a month billed yearly, for a 10-page site with 3GB of storage, SSL and a blog, and no shop. Professional is €19.99, or €16.66 billed yearly, for 50 pages, 10GB, 50 custom HTML integrations, 3 custom forms, one website administrator and a shop of up to 250 products with discount codes and sales. Business is €39.99, or €33.33 billed yearly, for unlimited pages and products, 20GB, 200 HTML integrations, 15 forms, three administrators and the selling tools Professional leaves out: abandoned basket recovery, Instagram and Facebook Shopping, digital products, Google Shopping, Klarna and PayPal pay-later, automatic Pinterest Shopping, product customisation and Royal Mail Click & Drop. Tailored starts at €79.99, or €69.99 billed yearly, with all limits removable and permissions for unlimited staff. Every package includes hosting, SSL and an account manager; the two smaller packages get UK-based email support, Business priority support. The page offers a free trial without stating its length, and adds VAT at your country's rate. Create is based in Brighton, UK; its copyright line runs from 2001. Re-read on 27 October 2026 with a plain fetch from the Netherlands: the same euro prices on both billing options (Portfolio €9.99 or €8.33 billed yearly, Professional €19.99 or €16.66, Business €39.99 or €33.33, Tailored from €79.99 or €69.99), still marked as exclusive of VAT. Create's terms and conditions, read the same day, say the opposite, that subscription prices include VAT, and promise at least 30 days' notice of any price change.

compare_with.name: Webflow
compare_with.why: Webflow is the other website builder in our own dossiers, and the two are built for different people. Webflow, re-verified on 29 September 2026 in dollars on yearly billing, charges a site plan ($25 a month with CMS), a workspace plan and $39 a month per full seat, and its ecommerce starts with Standard at $29 for 500 items and a 2% transaction fee, or Plus at $74 for 5,000 items without the fee. Create, read on 3 October 2026 in euros excluding VAT, is one bill per site: €19.99 a month for a 250-product shop or €39.99 for unlimited products and the full selling toolkit, with no per-seat charge but only one or three administrators. Webflow suits designers who want control of every layout and are ready to add up three bills; Create suits owners who want a template, a shop and an account manager to ring.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 18 November 2026 the session set up a trial of the Create site builder. The first attempt with the template Thread stayed on a loading screen for more than 4 minutes and ended with You don't currently have access to any sites, so no site was made. The second attempt, through the Create New Site wizard of 3 steps, gave a first page about 18 seconds after the template choice (18:44:07 to 18:44:25), and a changed heading, an added block and a stock photo from Unsplash were saved at 18:46:36, about 2.5 minutes in all. The trial lasts 30 days, but the site cannot be published in it: Publish says that a plan is needed, and no card field or domain question appeared. The in-app prices are 12.09, 24.19 and 48.39 euro a month, which are the dossier monthly prices with VAT added (the public page shows 8.33, 16.66 and 33.33 euro billed yearly, excluding VAT). Nothing was published, bought or cancelled. Account and start: we created the account (app.create.net, Create, Brighton UK, 25 years) and our AI assistant ran the test in his browser from 18:40 (Amsterdam). The interface was already in English and the first screen was Choose your website template. The dossier name is Create and the review is on AIBM (the b2b section, review page of Create). Audience: the request named Beginners building a first site (pain: I want a site without a designer and without a card). The dossier has no group for beginners; the best fit is UK makers and small shops selling physical goods, whose pain is a hosted site instead of a builder learned alone. Attempt 1: the template Thread was chosen at 18:40:22. The page new-site-loading stayed on the loading screen for more than 4 minutes, with the messages Customising your design..., Adding the finishing touches..., Applying your options... and Almost there... in a loop. Afterwards the sites list said You don't currently have access to any sites, so no site had been made. Attempt 2: Create New Site started a wizard of 3 steps (What's your site called?, What's your site about? with Crafts, and What content do you need? with Home, Services, Shop, Blog, Contact, About and Gallery as standard), begun at 18:43:33. The wizard fills the first part of the site name itself; that was not typed and is not shown. The template Thread was chosen again at 18:44:07 (Choose Template). Core action: at 18:44:25, about 18 seconds after the choice, the dashboard Home stood there and the homepage of the template already had a heading, a button, texts, testimonials and a footer. The page was edited through Content, Pages and the edit icon (an intro dialog Introducing Content Pages in 60 Seconds was closed): the heading was replaced by My first test site, and a new block Heading Text (Add Block, 322 blocks to choose from) with the heading Hello from my test page was added at the bottom; the message Save successful appeared. Image: Block Settings, Style, Background, Select Image opened the Image Library, which said You do not currently have any images in your library. So Import Stock Images (Unsplash, Photos supplied by Unsplash) was used with the search term yarn; the message Successfully imported into your images and Image uploaded followed, and the photo was set as the background of the first block. Nothing was uploaded from the laptop. Time: template chosen at 18:44:07, first page at 18:44:25, heading, image and extra block edited and saved at 18:46:36, so about 2.5 minutes in all; attempt 1 took more than 4 minutes without a result. Limits of the trial: the dashboard bar says You have 29 days remaining on your trial. Upgrade now to enable your website. with the button Upgrade Now; the task list offers Get a discount for your first subscription payment (15 percent), The Design area, Add an image, Create a holding page, Register a Domain and Publish your website. Publish opens Ready to publish? Upgrade to one of our plans and publish your website today! and the line that on a free trial the site cannot be published to the web or use advanced features yet. So publishing is not possible in the trial, also not for free on a subdomain of the builder; nothing was published. Plans up to the payment: Read by the tester on 18 Nov 2026. Public pricing page (billed annually, excluding VAT; the page says Prices displayed are exclusive of VAT): Business 33.33 euro a month, Professional 16.66 euro, Portfolio 8.33 euro. Limits: Pages 10 (Portfolio), 50 (Professional), Unlimited (Business); storage 3GB, 10GB and 20GB; Custom HTML Integrations none, 50 and 200; Custom Forms none, 3 and 15; Website Administrators none, 1 and 3; Professional has a shop of 250 products; the support line is UK Based Email Support for Portfolio and Professional and UK Based Priority Support for Business. Inside the app, after Upgrade Now (monthly view): Business 48.39 euro a month (Pay yearly to save 96.78 euro), Professional 24.19 euro (marked most popular, Pay yearly to save 48.38 euro), Portfolio 12.09 euro (Pay yearly to save 24.18 euro). The session notes read these as the monthly prices including VAT at 21 percent, which equals the dossier monthly prices (9.99, 19.99 and 39.99 euro) with VAT added; the difference with the dossier is VAT, not a price change. FAQ on the pricing page: Can I try before I buy? Oh yes, a no-obligation free trial; you can choose to pay monthly or yearly and you can cancel your account at any time; domains can be found, bought and registered with Create; every package comes with an Account Manager. Trial in the app: 30 days (the bar says You have 29 days remaining on your trial on the first day); Publish says that on a free trial the site cannot be published to the web and advanced features are not available yet, so a payment is needed to publish, on every plan; the app showed no card field and no question about a domain, and no Choose button was clicked, so no checkout total, tax or fee line was seen. A discount of 15 percent on the first subscription payment is offered in a task of the dashboard (not used). Prices were not changed by this delivery. Cancelling: not tested; the pricing page says that you can cancel your account at any time and the dashboard has Manage Subscription, but there is no paid plan; the account and the site stay. Not tested: publishing (needs a paid plan), connecting or buying a domain, branding on the trial site, a payment screen, cancelling and a shop with products. Clean up (still so): the account, the test site (template Thread, subject Crafts), the stock photo in the image library and the trial (29 days) stay; attempt 1 left no site; the browser tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The first attempt hung on a loading screen and left no site, with no error message. A trial site can be built and previewed but not published, also not on a free subdomain, so the free trial does not give a live site. The in-app prices include VAT and the public page shows yearly prices excluding VAT, so the numbers differ. The image library starts empty, and a photo has to be imported from Unsplash or uploaded first.
